ingredients.name: Kakadu Plum
ingredients.shortDesc: Kakadu plum has 100 times more Vitamin C than an orange and is the richest natural source of Vitamin C
ingredients.longDesc: Kakadu plum has 100 times more Vitamin C than an orange and is the richest natural source of Vitamin C. This face serum is enriched with such skin vitamins to give you a glowing and blemish-free skin

ingredients.name: Niacinamide
ingredients.shortDesc: Also known as Vitamin B3, niacinamide is rich in antioxidants that fight hyperpigmentation
ingredients.longDesc: Also known as Vitamin B3, niacinamide is rich in antioxidants that fight hyperpigmentation. Man Matters Niacinamide serum uses free fatty acids to form a shield that protects your skin from losing moisture and appearing dull.

howToUse: Use this face serum for men in the day or before going to bed every night. Wash your face with Man Matter's face wash and pat it dry with a clean napkin. Take 4-5 drops of the Niacinamide Serum in your palm. Gently massage this Niacinamide Face Serum for men into your skin until it is completely absorbed. If you use the Face Serum in the morning, top it off with a sunscreen

faqs.question: How long must I use this Face Serum to see results?
faqs.answer: Most nutritional health transformations take place over time, our serum takes around 2-3 months to show results.

faqs.question: What is Kakadu Plum?
faqs.answer: Kakadu Plum is a fruit grown in Northern Australia and is extremely rich in Vitamin C. It is rich in antioxidants and stimulates collagen production.

faqs.question: Why do I need an external supply of Vitamin C or a Vitamin C serum?
faqs.answer: UV rays, pollution damage your skin and deplete the Vitamin C in your skin. To replenish Vitamin C and keep your skin healthy, you need an external supply of vitamin C.

faqs.question: What are the side effects of Niacinamide Face Serum for men?
faqs.answer: Neither Vitamin C nor niacinamide have side effects. If you are using Vitamin C and niacinamide for the first time, use the product with lower frequency. When your skin is is accustomed to the serum, use as per instructions.

faqs.question: What should I keep in mind while using this Face Serum?
faqs.answer: Store Below 30°C.Shake well before use.Close cap tightly after using.Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children.

faqs.question: Is this Face Serum for oily skin as well?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Face Serum is suitable for all skin types.

faqs.question: Is the Niacinamide Serum a paraben free face serum?
faqs.answer: Yes. Man Matters Niacinamide Serum is a paraben free face serum.
